Name: Sunset Garden Greenhouse
Author: lanterncat
Description:
Sunset Garden Greenhouse is a replacement for the default greenhouse interior.

[b]FEATURES:[/b]
﻿- Changes with each season
﻿- Multiple floors
﻿- An attic where it is always night, with a bed to sleep in
﻿- Area for trellis crops
﻿- Space for 60 trees!
﻿- Lamp posts for lighting
﻿- Multiple water sources that can be used to refill the watering can

[b]INSTALLATION:[/b]
﻿- Unzip into mod folder. Enjoy!

[b]CREDITS:[/b]
﻿- [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/9139916]DustBeauty[/url] for the dirt, grass, trees, and bushes ([url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/4705]Stardew Foliage Redone - A Nature Toned Map Recolour[/url])
﻿- [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/34984615]Eemiestardew[/url] for the lampposts ([url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/473]here[/url]) and butterflies ([url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1111]here[/url])
